title: Toolbinding fidelity watchtower: model/config regression sentinel and argument integrity suite
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a config-aware eval harness ("Watchtower Suite") that continuously measures tool/function selection fidelity and argument integrity across model and config changes. The harness should: run nightly and on model/config rollout; maintain per-model and per-config baselines; surface statistically significant regressions; validate argument schemas and sanitization behavior; and integrate with Console alerts and the regression dashboard. This ticket covers engineering the harness, the alerting rules, and shipping a lightweight onboarding guide for SREs and SDK teams.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly Watchtower job executes across all supported models and configured tool routing policies without manual intervention
Per-model and per-config baselines stored in metrics store (Prometheus or ClickHouse) with clear version tags
Regression detector triggers when tool-selection accuracy drops by >3% (p<0.01) compared to baseline and when argument validation false-positive rate increases >1%
Automated triage payload (example traces, failing prompts, model+config diff) posted to the Console regression dashboard and Slack channel #invocation-regressions
Smoke tests and canary gating added to model rollout flow: model cannot be promoted to prod if Watchtower reports a critical regression
Documentation and runbook published (Confluence) with steps to reproduce, rollback, and mitigate false positives
implementation_plan: Define canonical evaluation prompts and golden tool-selection labels from existing datasets and production telemetry
Implement Watchtower harness as a k8s CronJob with configurable model/config matrix and sampling budget
Add argument validation fuzzing stage that mutates arguments to detect brittle sanitizers and missing schema checks
Hook regression detector into Console metrics pipeline; emit structured regression events for dashboard and alerting
Create unit/integration tests and gating in CI; wire canary checks into the model promotion pipeline
Roll out to a subset of models (3) as pilot, iterate on thresholds and signal quality, then expand coverage
metrics_targets: Baseline tool_selection.accuracy >= 95% for critical tool routes
False alarm rate < 5% for regression alerts during pilot
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Overfitting baselines to current model behavior leading to false positives. Mitigation: maintain rolling 30-day baselines and weight recent data with exponential decay.
Risk: High compute cost for nightly evals. Mitigation: adaptive sampling and cached KV prefixes to reduce token footprint; pilot on sampled traffic first.
Risk: Alert fatigue from low-signal regressions. Mitigation: require statistical significance (p-value) and minimum delta; add alert severity tiers and manual confirmation workflow.
